description: Catalogue of built-in configuration profiles (URS-101). A profile name states what the profile IS — its tallied category count and defining trait. Provenance, endorsement and rationale live in `description` and `provenance.notes`, as facts with citations. Value and status words (legacy, consensus, harmonized, modern, classic, full, minimal, standard) are not used in names; VV-PRE-030..033 enforce this. Each entry is a starting point a laboratory can load and then adapt in the configuration editor. Profiles marked editorOnly cannot be counted with as-is.

presets.name: 14-Type Nucleated Differential
presets.summary: The 13 ICSH 2008 §2.6 nucleated differential categories plus an `other` category with scope guidance. BM 500, PB 200; NRBC reported per 100 WBC in blood.

presets.name: 10-Type — Bands+Segs Combined
presets.summary: Ten tallied categories; band and segmented neutrophils counted as one granulocyte category. Promyelocytes separate.

presets.name: 10-Type — Bands & Segs Separate
presets.summary: Ten tallied categories matching mechanical bench-counter layouts: bands and segmented neutrophils counted separately.

presets.name: 5-Type — Analyzer Categories
presets.summary: The five categories automated analyzers report: neutrophils, lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, basophils. Peripheral blood only.

presets.name: Body Fluid — 7 Types
presets.summary: Seven categories for CSF, serous and synovial fluid differentials, including mesothelial and malignant cells.

presets.name: 9-Type — 2015 Counter Layout
presets.summary: Nine tallied categories reproducing the 2015 predecessor counter's key layout, with its Yale SOM, Precipio DX and MGH report templates.

presets.name: Custom (Blank Template)
presets.summary: Empty starting point for building a profile from scratch in the configuration editor.
